title: init --as mcp-llm funnel — shell-out to grove-explore config + graceful PATH degrade

plan.objective: Wire `grove init --as mcp-llm` to shell out to `grove-explore config`, falling back to a graceful PATH-absent degrade that still registers both servers and exits 0.
key_changes: Replace the sibling-directory lookup in `cli/src/init.rs` with a PATH probe via `which::which("grove-explore")`.
Introduce a command-value fallback that writes the bare string `grove-explore` into MCP registrations when the sibling is absent.
Restructure the first-run TUI block so the non-TTY fast-fail is conditional on the sibling being on PATH.
When `grove-explore` is absent from PATH, degrade: complete harness reconciliation, print setup message, exit 0.
Update `write_json_mcp_explore_server` and `write_toml_mcp_explore_server` to use the fallback command value.
Add PATH-controlled integration tests for the degrade path and the non-TTY fail-fast path in `cli/tests/cli.rs`.
Leave `--dry-run`, non-mcp-llm targets, and the existing transition-matrix semantics unchanged.
Workspace green: `cargo test --release --locked` and clippy with warnings-as-errors.

review_plan.objective: Reviewed the revised plan for wiring grove init --as mcp-llm to shell out to grove-explore config with a graceful PATH-absent degrade, verifying both prior critical findings are resolved.
key_changes: Finding #1 resolved: Approach §1+§3 add a command-value fallback helper and update the two explore-server write functions to use bare-name fallback instead of erroring.
Finding #2 resolved: Approach §2 states PATH probe happens before TTY decision, with a complete 4-cell decision matrix (PATH x TTY).
Verified: find_explore_binary (init.rs:607) returns sibling path with no existence check; which::which already used at init.rs:284; which=7 in Cargo.toml.
Verified: reconcile_harness_for dispatches to the two write functions via write_explore_harness_registration — the exact degrade path that must complete.
Verified: main.rs find_explore_binary already falls back to bare 'grove-explore' — plan's mirror claim is accurate.
Testing strategy covers both CI-testable paths (degrade + non-TTY fail-fast); TTY shell-out limitation correctly acknowledged.
Advisory: already_configured and dry_run bypasses must be preserved in the restructured guard.
Advisory: two-block restructure requires storing PATH probe result for later use or merging the blocks.

implementation.objective: Make the degrade-path integration test for `grove init --as mcp-llm` deterministic by controlling the child PATH so `grove-explore` is provably absent.
key_changes: Renamed `grove_mcp_llm_with_extra_path` to `grove_mcp_llm_with_path` and changed semantics so a supplied path becomes the child's entire PATH, not a prepend to the parent PATH.
Updated `init_first_run_grove_explore_absent_degrades` to run with an empty temporary directory as the only PATH entry, deterministically excluding `grove-explore`.
Updated `init_first_run_grove_explore_present_non_tty_fails_fast` to run with only the build-artifacts directory on PATH, deterministically including `grove-explore`.
No runtime source changes in `cli/src/init.rs`; the PATH probe, shell-out, fail-fast, and degrade behavior were already correct.

code_review.objective: Reviewed the implementation wiring grove init --as mcp-llm to shell out to grove-explore config with a PATH-aware 4-cell decision matrix and graceful degrade when the sibling is absent.
key_changes: Spec compliance verified independently via git diff + cargo test --release --locked (341 passed) + clippy -D warnings clean.
All 9 ACs satisfied: both-server registration, PATH+TTY shell-out, PATH+non-TTY fail-fast, absent-PATH degrade (exit 0 + setup hint), dry-run isolation, non-McpLlm unchanged, workspace green.
explore_binary_on_path() (Option) cleanly separates presence from explore_command_value() (always-succeeds PathBuf) — correct split for guard vs writers.
write_json/toml_mcp_explore_server now use explore_command_value(), so reconcile_harness_for completes during degrade instead of erroring.
Old find_explore_binary removed from init.rs; main.rs retains its own copy for deprecated shims — consistent with plan.
Both new integration tests (absent_degrades + present_non_tty_fails_fast) verified green; grove_mcp_llm_with_extra_path cleanly extends the existing helper.
Advisory: which::which invoked up to 4x per init run (guard + first-run block + 2 writers) — not a correctness issue for a one-shot CLI.
Advisory: degrade test inherits parent PATH rather than actively excluding grove-explore; robust in CI, could flake on a dev box with a global install.
Advisory: interactive-terminal bail message duplicated verbatim between top guard and defensive re-check — a const would prevent drift.

approve.objective: Architectural sign-off on the mcp-llm init funnel: PATH-aware shell-out to grove-explore config with a graceful degrade when the sibling is absent.
key_changes: 4-cell decision matrix (PATH x TTY) in run() is the correct factoring; presence and interactivity are probed independently.
explore_binary_on_path() (guard) vs explore_command_value() (always-succeeds writer) split is the load-bearing invariant that makes graceful degrade work.
Both write_json_mcp_explore_server and write_toml_mcp_explore_server consume explore_command_value(), so reconcile_harness_for completes during degrade instead of erroring.
Non-mcp-llm init modes are byte-identical to T04; all gating is on target == McpLlm. 43 existing cli integration tests pass unchanged.
No schema changes; GroveConfig persistence unchanged; .forge/store and .forge/config.json untouched.
Dry-run isolation preserved: --dry-run returns before the first-run block and before reconcile; no shell-out, no writes.
main.rs retains its own find_explore_binary for deprecated config/tap shims (T05); init.rs copy removed — consistent with plan.
Independent verification: cargo test --release --locked = 341 passed, 0 failed; clippy -D warnings warning-free.
Both PATH-controlled integration tests are deterministic: absent-path test uses an empty temp dir as the child's entire PATH.
Advisory (non-blocking): interactive-terminal bail message duplicated between top guard and defensive re-check — a const would prevent drift.
Advisory (non-blocking): which::which invoked up to 4x per init run; caching the probe in run() would be cleaner for a one-shot CLI.
Distribution: ships on next release train; full installs get grove-explore config UX, minimal installs degrade gracefully — the intended funnel improvement.
